title: DLR-DAAD Research Fellowship Programme
summary: Fellowships for foreign graduate, doctoral, postdoctoral researchers, and senior scientists to conduct research at DLR institutes in Germany across aeronautics, space, energy, and transportation.

degree_levels.notes: Intended for foreign graduate (enrolled in Master's) and doctoral students as well as postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists.

subject_areas.notes: Research fields: Aeronautics, Space, Energy, Transportation.

institutions.notes: You can only apply for a DLR institute, not for a university or any other institution.

nationality.notes: Not of German nationality, or main place of residence outside of Germany for at least six years.

residence.notes: Applicants must not be of German nationality, or must be able to prove that the main place of residence lies outside of Germany for at least six years.

mandatory.text: Not be of German nationality or have main place of residence outside Germany for at least six years
Prove outstanding study or research achievements in the corresponding research field
Excellent knowledge of English; knowledge of German is advantageous

funding.description: Type A – Graduate Students: monthly instalment of 992 euros; plus e.g. flat-rate travel allowance, rent subsidy, health insurance, family allowances. Type B – Doctoral Students: monthly instalment of 1,760 euros; plus e.g. flat-rate travel allowance, health insurance, family allowances. Type C – Postdoctoral Researchers: monthly instalment of 2,400. Type D – Senior Scientists: monthly instalment of 2,760 euros. Type E – Visiting Researchers PhD level: monthly instalment of 1,760 euros; plus health insurance, flat-rate travel allowance. Postdoc level: monthly instalment of 2,400 euros.
funding.duration: Type A: 9 months; Type B: 36 months; Type C: 7 to 24 months; Type D: 1 to 3 months; Type E: 1 to 6 months

application_rounds.notes: If an application deadline exists, it is mentioned in the current offers. Currently you cannot apply for this programme.

required_documents.text: Statement of the reasons for applying for a certain fellowship (Appendix)

steps.text: Request recommendation form and have referees submit letters of recommendation
Prepare application documents and upload in PDF format
Submit the application online via the DAAD portal

sources.title: DLR-DAAD Research Fellowship Programme - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: International students and researchers can receive funding for physically researching in Germany at DLR institutes.
